rows.title: Karlobag, 2 May 1774 — Vincentius Smojver «Vukich» and Oliva, daughter of the late Caetanus Bacchi
rows.where: image 306, right-hand page: headed 1773, then «Anno Dni 1774»; the entry is the one with «Maij» in the left margin, the second under the 1774 heading
rows.says: «Praemissis praemittendis et habito mutuo consensu Vincentii filii Josephi Smojver, vulgo nuncupati Vukich, ac Olivae filiae defti Caetani Bacchi, eos per verba de praesenti solemniter matrimonio conjunxi, praesentibus Dno Nicolao Jurich et Francisco [Lukulich?]». The year is read from the heading above; the witnesses at one zoom.

rows.title: Karlobag, 20 October 1760 — Paulus Perpich marries Anna, widow of Caetanus Bachi
rows.where: image 293, left-hand page, headed «Anno Domini 1760»; the entry is the second of 20 October, the one beginning «Idem eadem die»
rows.says: «Idem eadem die matrimonialiter copulavi Paulum Perpich et Annam viduam Caetani Bachi. Praesentibus testibus Joanno Mat[hosich] ac Petro Bevandich». Shows a Caetanus Bacchi dead by October 1760; probably the elder Caetanus (ahnentafel 214) — not proved.

people.name: Anna, widow of Caetanus Bacchi (married Paulus Perpich)

rows.title: Karlobag, 4 February 1753 — Caetanus Bachi marries Anna, daughter of the late Alexius Lukatelli
rows.where: image 287, right-hand page: «Anno Domini 1752», then «Anno Domini 1753»; the entry is the last on the page, «Idem eadem die» after the 4 February entry
rows.says: «Idem eadem die matrimonialiter copulavi ad faciem Ecclesiae Cajetanum Bachi et Annam filiam defuncti Alexij Lukatelli. Praesentibus Wolffgango Suvich ac Joanne Radkovich». The father's surname is read from the full page.

people.name: Anna, daughter of the late Alexius Lukatelli (wife of Caetanus Bacchi)

rows.title: Karlobag, 22 November 1747 — Jakov Pilepich marries Katta, daughter of the late Vicko Luckinich
rows.where: image 283, right-hand page, headed «Letta 1747»: the entry dated «Dan 22: Novembra», second from the foot of the 1747 block (Croatian text)
rows.says: Croatian entry of the priest Andrij Kollekar joining «Jakova Lillepicha» (Pilepich) and «Kattu», the daughter «heer pokoif Vicka fucki[nicha]» — read as «daughter of the late Vicko Luckinich». The surnames are read at about 4x and are the least certain words.

rows.title: Karlobag, 2 November 1785 — Michael Gerkacs and Lucia, daughter of Paul Tomljanovic of Montani Stanize
rows.where: image 324, right-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1785»: the third entry, in the left margin «2 Novemb»
rows.says: «… matrimonio conjunxi ego Joes Antonius Ivankovich Parochus … Michaelis filij defti Nicolai Gergacs et Luciae Pauli Tomljenovich Loci Mostani [Montani] Stanize». Gives the groom's late father (ahnentafel 220) and the bride's father (222).

rows.title: Karlobag, 14 February 1798 — Josephus Pilepich (widower) and Maria, daughter of Vincentius (probable)
rows.where: image 343, right-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1798»: the second entry, in the left margin «14 Febr[uarij]»
rows.says: «… Josephi viduei [Pilepich?] et Mariae filiae Vincenti [Smojver?] …». Date, both first names and the father's given name fit; both surnames are faint, so the identification as ahnentafel 52 and 53 is probable, not proved.

rows.title: Karlobag, 5 February 1755 — Matthias Kriskovich marries Magdalena, daughter of Dominicus Uroda
rows.where: image 289, right-hand page: «Anno Domini 1754», then «1755»; the entry is the last on the page, «Die 5ta Febr»
rows.says: «Matthiam Kriskovich et Magdalenam filiam Dominici Uroda. Praesentibus Nicolao Perpich ac Josepho Venerando». A Dominicus Uroda with a daughter marrying in 1755; not shown to be related to Georgius Uroda (ahnentafel 108).

people.name: Magdalena, daughter of Dominicus Uroda (wife of Matthias Kriskovich)

rows.title: Karlobag, 13 November 1767 — a man of Senj marries Maria, daughter of the late Dominicus Uroda
rows.where: image 300, right-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1767»: the second entry, in the left margin «13 9bris»
rows.says: «… conjunxi Joannem [? underlined word] Senicensem et Mariam filiam defuncti Dominici Uroda, praesentibus testibus …». The groom's given name is read as Joannes (an earlier note of this archive said Josephus; the page reads Joannem, with an underlined word after it). Shows Dominicus Uroda dead by November 1767.

rows.title: Karlobag, 1748 — «Dominico Uroda» a witness at marriages (3, 5 October and 17 November)
rows.where: image 284, left-hand page, headed «Anno Domini 1748»: the entries of 3 and 5 October and 17 November each end «… et Dominico Uroda»
rows.says: Dominicus «Dume» Uroda appears as witness about ten times between 1744 and 1749; this page shows three. He was an adult Karlobag man by 1744 and dead by 1767. He may be the father of Georgius Uroda (ahnentafel 108); nothing read says so.

rows.title: Karlobag, 13 April 1725 — Ana, daughter of Vicko Luckinich and his wife Mare
rows.where: image 47, left-hand page, in the viewer's numbering (about book page 31): the entries of April 1725 are written near the foot, out of date order
rows.says: «Na 13 Aprilya 1725 Ja Pop Andrij Kollekar karstih [k]… Vicka Luckinicha, nyegove xene mare imen[om] Anu koy bi kum Sg. Karlo Slayner …». Read as a daughter Ana to Vicko and Mare; the index and the tree make «Mare» the child. The same page carries the godfather entry of 1724.

people.name: Ana, daughter of Vicko Luckinich and Mare (read «Anu»)

rows.title: Karlobag, 18 March 1753 — «Caietan Bachi» and his wife Anna as sponsors
rows.where: image 117, right-hand page, in the viewer's numbering (book page 211), headed «Letta 1753»: the entry «Dan 18: Marca» near the foot
rows.says: A baptism of a child of Petar Tomljenovich «Bihu kumi Caietan Bachi, svojom xenom Annom» — Caetanus with his wife Anna, six weeks after their wedding. Read at about 4x.

rows.title: Karlobag, early January 1754 — Silvester, son of Gaetanus and Anne Bachi
rows.where: image 119, right-hand page, in the viewer's numbering (book page 215), headed «Letta 1754»: the second entry under «Dan 1 Genvara» (dated 2 or 3 January)
rows.says: «… krstih Antola [Antonu?] Sylvestra sina Gajetana y Anne Bachi. Bihu kumi Jose y Venera Dur[…]ch». The first name is read at one zoom.

people.name: Silvester, son of Gaetanus and Anna Bachi

rows.title: Selce, 18 October 1798 — Joannes Antić and Martha Lončarić
rows.where: image 248, left-hand page, headed «Anno 1798»: the second entry, numbered 27 in the margin
rows.says: Latin entry of the chaplain Michael Kombol: «… Joannem filium defuncti Antonii et Ursulae Antich cum Martha filia Pauli et Annae Lonchasich», witnesses Mathia Jellichich and Georgio Antich. Names both sets of parents (ahnentafel 96–99).

rows.title: Selce, 14 October 1800 — Georgius Jelličić and Margaretha Drozović
rows.where: image 251, left-hand page, «Die 14 8bris Ao 1800»: the fourth entry, numbered 96 in the margin
rows.says: «… Georgium filium Mathiae et Margaritae Jellichich cum Margareta filia Joannis et Catharinae Drozovich, praesentibus Laurentio Allegri? et Joanne Drozovich». The bride's surname reads DROZOVICH, not the tree's Brozović. Names both sets of parents (ahnentafel 100–103).

rows.title: Kranj–Šmartin, 3 December 1775 — Franciscus Xaverius Kosina, son of Lucas and Helena (probably Franz Kosinar)
rows.film: Krstna knjiga Kranj–Šmartin 1747–1779 (Nadškofijski arhiv Ljubljana, Matricula sig. 00883)
rows.where: page 330, right-hand page: the second row, day «3», baptiser «Zeller», locus «S. Thomae» with the number 10
rows.says: Infans «Koskina Franciscus Xaverius», parents «Lucas et Helena Kosarsa [Kosina]», «Domus Paroch. Local», S. Thomae 10. The year is read from the heading «1776 Januarij» two pages on. Probable, not proved, to be the Franz Kosinar who died 1849.

people.name: Franciscus Xaverius Kosina, son of Lucas and Helena

rows.title: Karlobag, 10 April 1778 — Jacobus Pilepich, captain of the port, buried in his own crypt
rows.where: image 364, right-hand page (folio 17), headed «Anno Dni 1778»: the entry in the margin «10 Aprilis»
rows.says: «D. Jacobus Pilepich Capitaneus portûs, munitus omnibus Sacramentis per M.R. D. Andream Pintor Capellanum Loci, spiritum Deo reddidit … in propria Crypta in Parochiali Ecclesia existente … tumulatus est». Ahnentafel 104's death.

rows.title: Karlobag, 16 May 1776 — Josephus Smojver, called Vukcich, aged 45
rows.where: image 361, right-hand page (folio 11), headed «Anno Dni 1776»: the second entry under «Maij»
rows.says: «Josephus Smojver dictus Vukcich, annorum 45, munitus omnibus Sacramentis obiit in Domino atque die 17 … tumulatus est». Ahnentafel 212's death; the age puts his birth about 1731.

rows.title: Karlobag, 30 October 1783 — Nicolaus Gergacs, aged 66, died in his son Antonius's house
rows.where: image 376, right-hand page (folio 39), headed «Anno Dni 1783»: the entry «30 8bris»
rows.says: «Nicolaus Gergacs annorum 66, munitus omnibus sacramentis obiit in domo filij sui Antonij, et die 31 ejusdem sepultus est in Cemeterio laterali». Ahnentafel 220's death.

rows.title: Karlobag, 29 May 1790 — Catharina, aged 70, widow of the late Jacob Pilepich
rows.where: image 388, right-hand page (folio 63), headed «Anno Domini 1790»: the entry «29 ejusdem [Maij]», the last but one on the page
rows.says: «Catharina annorum 70 vidua defti Dni Capitanei Jacobi Pilepich obiit in Domino munita omnibus sacramentis, atque die 30 sepulta est». Ahnentafel 105's death; the age 70 puts her birth about 1720, which no baptism of 1717–1732 supports.

rows.title: Karlobag, 10 September 1791 — Dominus Georgius Uroda, buried in his own crypt (no age given)
rows.where: image 390, right-hand page (folio 67), headed «Anno Domini 1791»: the entry «10 ejusdem» under September, near the foot
rows.says: «Dñus Georgius Uroda, munitus omnibus Sacramentis, in domo sua obiit, atque die 12 sepultus est in propria sua Cripta ante fores Ecclesiae Parochialis existente». NO AGE is given, and no occupation. Ahnentafel 108's death.

rows.title: Karlobag, 19 September 1809 — Lucia, called Maja, wife of Michael Gergacs, aged 34
rows.where: image 125, left-hand page (page 12), headed «Annus Domini 1809»: the entry «19 [Sept]», fourth from the foot
rows.says: «Lucia, vulgo Maja, uxor Michaelis Gergacs, annorum 34, provisa omnibus sacramentis obiit in Domino, atque in propria crypta … humata est». Ahnentafel 111's death; an age of 34 cannot fit a marriage of 1785 and a daughter of 1789, so her age stays unresolved.

rows.title: Karlobag, 28 June 1828 — Josephus Pilepich, aged 61
rows.where: image 138, right-hand page (page 35), headed «Anno Domini 1828»: the entry of 28 June (margin «Junii»), about the fifth from the top
rows.says: «… Josephus Pilepich Carlobagensis annorum 61 in communione S. Matris Ecclesiae animam Deo reddidit, cujus corpus die 29 h. sepultum est in coemeterio S. Caroli». Ahnentafel 52's death, found through the book's index (KAZALO). The page is dense Latin and read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 6 August 1834 — Maria, wife of the fisherman Georgius Uroda, aged 45
rows.where: image 149, right-hand page (folio 52), headed «Anno Domini 1834»: an entry in the upper half of the page, among those of July–August
rows.says: «Maria uxor piscatoris Georgii Uroda annorum 45 …», died 6 August 1834 and buried the 7th. Ahnentafel 55's death (née Gerkacs, married 1807); it names her husband, ahnentafel 54, as a fisherman, still alive. The entry is small and was read at about 4x; find it by the word «piscatoris».

rows.title: Karlobag, March 1781 — Oliva Maria, daughter of Vincentius Smojver «Vukich» and Oliva
rows.where: image 217, right-hand page (book page 65), headed «Anno Domini 1781»: the seventh entry, margin «Ejusdem» under March
rows.says: «Ego Joes Antonius Ivankovich Parochus Loci baptizavi infantem natam ex Vincentio et Oliva Smoyver, vulgo Vukich, Conjugibus hujus Civitatis, cui impositum est nomen Oliva Maria». Ahnentafel 53's baptism; the parents are 106 and 107, married 7 years earlier (see the 1774 marriage).

rows.title: Karlobag, 21–22 April 1777 — Joannes Georgius, son of Georgius Uroda and Maria
rows.where: image 202, right-hand page (book page 37), headed «Anno Dni 1777»: the entry under the margin «Aprilis», second from the foot («Ego Joes Antius … ex Georgio et Maria Uroda … Joannis Georgij»)
rows.says: «Ego Joes Antius Ivankovich Parochus Loci baptizavi Infantem … ex Georgio et Maria Uroda Conjugibus hujus Loci, cui impositum est nomen Joannis Georgij». Ahnentafel 54's baptism, naming his parents (108 and 109); the godfather is a colonel. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Selce, 27 February 1793 — Antonius Antich Martini, aged about 54 (the given name is Antonius, not the tree's Joannes)
rows.where: image 81, left-hand page, headed «Anno 1793»: the fourth entry, house number 34 in the margin
rows.says: «Die 27a Februarii 793 Antonius Antich Martini annorum circiter 54 in communione S. Matris Ecclesiae … animam Deo creatori suo reddidit». The day, month and age are the tree's for ahnentafel 96; the first word is Antonius, underlined, where the tree has Joannes — recorded as evidence of an Antonius Antich, not as a settled reading of 96.

rows.title: Selce, 24 August 1807 — Anna, wife of Paulus Lončarich Papich, aged about 65
rows.where: image 110, left-hand page: the first entry at the top, house number 134 in the margin; the page ends with the note that the parish of Selce was founded in November or December 1807
rows.says: «Die 24a Mensis Augusti anno ut supra 1807. Anna uxor Pauli Lončarich Papich annorum circiter 65 in communione S. M. Ecclesiae … animam Deo creatori suo reddidit». Ahnentafel 99's death, entered with the by-name Papich.

rows.title: Selce, 29 September 1811 — Paulus Lončarich, widower, aged about 70
rows.where: image 120, RIGHT-hand page (printed page 111; the working note says left): the first entry at the top, «Die 29 7bis Ao 1811»
rows.says: «Die 29 7bis Ao 1811. Paulus Lončarich viduus annorum circiter 70 in communione S. M. Ecclesiae … animam Deo creatori suo reddidit». Ahnentafel 98's death; viduus fits the 1807 death of his wife; the house, 134, is read from the neighbouring left page's margin.

rows.title: Krivi Put, 12/15 May 1859 — Antonija Perpić, daughter of Joannes and Lucia Perpić, house 136
rows.where: image 64, left-hand page (printed page 110): entry 51, the fourth row of the page
rows.says: Born «12 Maji 1859», baptised «15 Maji 1859», Antonia Perpić, legit., parents «Joannis et Lucia Perpić», «Krivi put No 136», godparents Lucas and Anna Tomljanović. Ahnentafel 7's baptism, now read from the page (it had been index only).

rows.title: Krivi Put, 13/16 December 1861 — Stephanus Perpić, son of Joannes and Lucia Perpić, house 136
rows.where: image 78, left-hand page (printed page 134): entry 109, the fifth row, «10bris 1861» (December)
rows.says: «13. 10bris 1861 [born], 16. 10bris 1861 [baptised], Stephanus Perpić, Joannes Perpić & Lucia Perpić, Krivi put No 136». 10bris is December: the entries on the page run 30 November, 1, 7, 13, 13, 26 and 29 December, then «Annus 1862». Names ahnentafel 14 and 15 and the house; the tree's 13 October is wrong.

rows.title: Senj, 3 May 1885 — Josip Papić and Antonia Perpić (parents: Juraj Papa & Matia Pilipić; Ivan Perpić & Luca rođena Perpić)
rows.where: image 196, a two-page spread: the LEFT page (printed 191) has the couple, places and ages, the RIGHT page (printed p. 192) the parents, witnesses and priest; the entry is no. 5, the middle row of both
rows.says: Left: «5. 1885 dne 3 Svibnja · Josip Papić, bremenar, Senj, 27, neoženjen · Antonia Perpić, Krivi put / Senj, 25 [?]». Right: parents «Juraj Papa težak i Matia rođena Pilipić» and «Ivan Perpić seljak i Luca rođena Perpić», witnesses Franjo Perpić and Tomo Perpić, priest Mirko Babić kapelan. Names ahnentafel 12, 13, 14 and 15 and gives Lucia's maiden name as Perpić; the bride's age figure is blotted and read at one zoom.

rows.title: Senj, 12 January 1888 — Martin Kozina of Kranj and Angjelika Boras
rows.where: image 214, a two-page spread: the LEFT page (printed 210) has the couple, origin, domicile and ages, the RIGHT page (printed p. 209) the parents, witnesses and priest; the entry is no. 1, the top row of both
rows.says: Left: «1. 1888 dne 12 Siječnja · Martin Kozina, trgovac · Kranjska župa sv. Martina kod Kranjburg [Kranj] · Senj · rim. kat. · 47 · neoženjen — Angjelika Boras, šivačica · Senj · 30 · neudata». Right: parents «Gertruda Kozina, posjednica» (property-owner, with a dash where the father would be) and «Josip Boras, gradski stražar, i Maria rođena Kabalin»; witnesses Mile Crnković, trgovac, and Ivan Boras; priest Mirko Babić, kapelan; banns dispensed (read on 7 January 1888). The page that names Martin Kozina's origin as the parish of Kranj–Šmartin.

rows.title: Senj, 5 October 1913 — Josip Nagoda and Tereza Blažević, born 23 October 1888, of Krmpote
rows.where: image 331, a two-page spread: the LEFT page (printed p. 326) has the couple, origin, domicile and birth dates, the RIGHT page the parents, witnesses and priest; the entry is no. 23, the last row of both
rows.says: Left: «23. 1913 listopada 5 · Nagoda Josip, [occupation] · Blažević Tereza, radnica u tvornici duhana u Senju · Krmpote · born 1888 23/10, unmarried». Right: the bride's parents «Pavao Blažević i Marija rođ. Tomljanović, poljodjelci iz župe sv. Jakov Krmpote». Confirms the tree's birth date for Tereza (23 October 1888) and names her parents; Pavao and Marija are ahnentafel 4's brother and sister-in-law, not direct ancestors.

rows.title: Senj, 1 April 1918 — Vinko Potočnjak and Antonija Blažević, born 12 May 1884
rows.where: image 353, a two-page spread: the LEFT page (printed p. 348) has the couple, the RIGHT page the parents, witnesses and priest; the entry is no. 5, the bottom row of both
rows.says: Left: «5. 1918 travnja 1 · Potočnjak Vinko [occupation], widower [read at one zoom], b. 1888 4/4 · Blažević Antonija, nadglednica u tvornici duhana, Senj, b. 1884 12/5, unmarried». Right: parents «Blažević Pavao i Marija rođ. Tomljanović, poljodjelci iz župe Krmpote», witnesses Josip Nagoda and Franjo Blažević, priest Josip Benac; banns read three times. The birth «1884 12/5» is the register's, where the tree says 17 May.

rows.title: Senj, 12 May 1919 — Viktor Matijević and Katica Blažević, of Krmpote
rows.where: image 360, a two-page spread: the LEFT page (printed p. 355) has the couple, the RIGHT page the parents, witnesses and priest; the entry is no. 18, the fourth row from the foot of the left page
rows.says: Left: «18. 1919 12 svibnja · Viktor Matijević [occupation], Senj · Katica Blažević, radnica u tvornici duhana, Krmpote / Senj, b. 1885 19/10». Right: the bride's parents «Pavao Blažević i Marija rođ. Tomljanović» and the groom's «Mate Matijević i Lucija rođ. Tomljanović». Confirms the tree's birth date for Katica.

rows.title: Senj, 20 November 1919 — Pavao Kosina and Anka Blažević (and, on 24 November, Antun Kosina)
rows.where: image 364, a two-page spread: the LEFT page (printed p. 359) has the couples, the RIGHT page the parents, witnesses and priest; the entries are no. 44 (the top row) and no. 46 (the third row)
rows.says: Left: «44. 1919 studenoga 20 · Pavao Kosina, trgovac, Senj, b. 1894 [day] · Anka Blažević, radnica u tvornici duhana, Otočac [?]/Senj, b. 1893» and «46. studenoga 24 · Antun Kosina, trgovac · Anka Kasnić? …». Right: both grooms' parents «+ Martin Kozina i Anđelika r. Boras»; Anka's «Juraj Blažević i Tereza r. Žubrinić» (ahnentafel 4 and 5). Names the same widow Anđelika Boras on two entries of one page.

rows.title: Senj, 9 February 1886 — Matija Pilepić, wife of Vicko Pilepić, aged 78
rows.where: image 370, left-hand page: entry no. 13, the sixth row (the page is headed by the year 1886; entries of 29 January to 9 February)
rows.says: «13. 1886 dne 9 veljače · Matija Pilepić, žena · Vicko Pilepić, fin. stražar u miru, njezin muž · Karlobag [birthplace] · Senj · rim. kat. · 78». Ahnentafel 27's death, naming her husband (ahnentafel 26) with his occupation. A printed Latin-and-Croatian table, read at about 3x.

rows.title: Senj, 14 November 1897 — Vicko Pilepić, retired financial guard, widower, «navodno 93»
rows.where: image 513, left-hand page (printed p. 98): entry no. 70, the eighth row, «1897 studenoga 14»
rows.says: «70. 1897 studenoga 14 · Vicko Pilepić, finanse nadmernar [finan. nadzornik?] u miru · Udovac · Karlobag · Senj · rim. kat. · navodno 93 god.». Ahnentafel 26's death; the clerk marks the age as hearsay («navodno»), and the page gives no cause in this crop.

rows.title: Senj, 26 July 1907 — Toma Blažević, day-labourer, widower of the late Tereza, aged 69
rows.where: image 640, left-hand page (printed p. 225): entry no. 60, the fifth row, «1907 srpnja 26»
rows.says: «60. 1907 srpnja 26 · Blažević Toma, nadničar · Udovac iza pok. Tereze · [born] sv. Jakov Krmpote · Senj · Rk. · 69 god.». Ahnentafel 8's death: the register names his late wife Tereza (ahnentafel 9), putting her death before 1907. The cause column is on the right-hand page, which was not captured.

rows.title: Otočac, 8 September 1835 — Maria Catharina Orešković, daughter of Marcus Oreskovich «adoptatus Sekula» and Lucia née Sekula, Dubrava 29
rows.film: Otočac births 1834–1846 (FamilySearch waypoint 9RK1-N3B; printed Latin table)
rows.where: image 13, right-hand half of the image (printed page number 10): entry no. 41, the second row, «1835 Septembris die 8va»
rows.says: «Maria Catharina, filia legitima, Confiniarius ex Pago Dubrava N° D.29, Marcus Oreskovich, adoptatus [Sekula], et Lucia uxor ejus nata Sekula, Catholici», sponsors and the baptising chaplain Matthaeus Mattasich in the next columns; protocol no. 41. Ahnentafel 21's baptism, naming her parents (ahnentafel 42 and 43) and the house.

rows.title: Otočac, 4 January 1838 — Thomas Xubrinich, border-guardsman, of Šumećica No. 2, aged 70
rows.where: image 117, right-hand half (printed page 45): entry no. 3 of «Anno Domini 1838», the third row below the year heading
rows.says: «1838 Januarii die 4ta · Thomas Xubrinich, Incola Otočanus Centuriae Confiniariae, ex Pago Shumechiza N° 2 · aet. 70 · Senectutis debilitas · … Matthaeus Mattasich, Administrator [priest]; protocol no. 3». Ahnentafel 40's death; the house, Šumećica 2, is the house of his son's and grandson's later baptisms.

rows.title: Otočac, 29 July 1849 — Maria Žubrinić, widow, aged 69, buried in the parish vault
rows.where: image 167, left-hand half (printed page 153): entry no. 53, the third row, «Leta 1849 dne 29 Srpnja»
rows.says: «Leta 1849 dne 29 Srpnja preminula je · Maria Žubrinić, udovica · 69 · slaboća starosti po dokazu liečnika · sa svetimi otajstvi umirućih providjena · u župničkoj grobnici»; protocol no. 53. Ahnentafel 41's death, entered under her married name; the register does not give her maiden name (Findrić), which comes from other documents. Read at about 3x in a Croatian-language table.

rows.title: Otočac, 3 July 1856 — Stephanus, son of Nicolaus Xubrinich and Anna «nata Štrumbulko», Šumećica No. 2
rows.where: image 76, right-hand half (the page after 18 June 1856, printed number 137): entry no. 49, the seventh row, «Anno Domini 1856 die 3 Julii»
rows.says: «Stephanus, filius legitimus, Romano-Catholicus · Confiniarius ex Pago Shumechiza N° 2 · [father] Nicolaus Xubrinich et [mother] Anna uxor ejus nata Štrumbulko [Strumbulko], Romano-Catholici», baptised by Josephus Mazuranić, parish priest; protocol no. 49. Names ahnentafel 10 and 11 and the house; the mother is entered here with the by-name Štrumbulko and in 1858 as Marić. The surnames are read at one zoom from a dense Latin table; the entry was found by the date and house number.

rows.title: Kranj–Šmartin, 16 November 1841 — Martin, born at Oberfeichting (Zgornje Bitnje) No. 9, to Gertraud Kosina, no father named

rows.title: Selce, 14 March 1806 — Josephus, son of Joannes and Martha Antich «Papa», house 44

Ahnentafel 24's baptism, with the by-name Papa underlined. The page header reads 1806; the priest signs C.L. (Capellanus Loci).

Ahnentafel 25's baptism; the by-name is underlined. The first entry on the page, so unmistakable.

The by-name Papa is underlined. Ahnentafel 24 × 25, naming 48, 49, 50 and 51. A loose slip of paper lies over the top left of the right-hand page. The prose is dense Latin, read at about 2x; entry 81 is the one the working note transcribes.

rows.title: Senj, 1 November 1857 — Josephus, son of Joannes Papa and Mathia Pilipić (godparents Michael and Catharina Stipančić)

Levantibus patrinis: + Michael Stipančić, + Catharina [..]». Ahnentafel 6's baptism, naming his parents (ahnentafel 12 and 13). Read at about 2x; the surname «Papa» is underlined as in Selce.

rows.title: Karlobag, 23 April 1810 — Mathia Georgia, daughter of Georgius and Maria Uroda (godparents Jacobus Blazevich and Maria, wife of Joannes Uroda)
rows.where: image 19, right-hand page, headed «Anno Domini 1810» (book page 10): the entry in the margin «23. [April]», the row directly below the 15 April entry (the one beginning «Vincentiam Mariam…») and directly above the «24» entry

Ahnentafel 27's baptism: parents ahnentafel 54 and 55. The godfather is a Blazevich of Karlobag. Latin cursive read at about 1.5x; the left page of this image is headed 1809.

rows.title: Karlobag, 18 September 1838 — Matthea, daughter of the chamber shipmaster Vincentius Pilipich and Mathea Uroda

Patrini fuerunt Antonius Kuchulian … et Oliva filia dicti Josephi Pilipich mercatoris». Ahnentafel 13's baptism, naming her parents (ahnentafel 26 and 27). The line is dense Latin at about 1.5x; the title cammeralis nauta (chamber seaman) is read here from the left-page line the working note transcribes.

rows.title: Karlobag, 2 November 1763 — Georgius and his wife Maria Uroda stand godparents to Carolus, son of Paulus and Ursula Smojver
rows.where: image 149, left-hand page (book page 266), headed «Anno Domini 1763»: the first entry on the page, «Die 2da Novembris»
rows.says: «Die 2da Novembris. Josephus Suvich Parochus baptizavi Carolum filium Pauli et Ursulae Smoivar, levantibus e sacro Fonte patrinis Georgio ac ejus conjuge Maria Uroda». The first time this archive has seen Georgius and Maria Uroda together as a couple in a register, six months before the baptism of their first known child; the godchild's family name is written «Smoivar», read as Smojver (the surname of ahnentafel 212 and 106) but not proved to be the same family. The husband's surname is not written, only the wife's, and the page does not say these are ahnentafel 108 and 109.

rows.title: Karlobag, 6 May 1764 — Joannes Dominicus, son of Georgius and Maria Uroda (godparents Antonio Barach of Šibenik and Vincentia, wife of Joannes Margvart)
rows.where: image 151, left-hand page (book page 270), headed «Anno Domini 1764»: the second entry, «Die 6ta May»
rows.says: «Die 6ta May. Jose: Suvich Parochus baptizavi Joannem Dominicum filium Georgij et Maria Uroda, levantibus a sacro Fonte patrinis Antonio Barach e [Šibenik] ac Vincentia conjuge Joannis Margvart». The child's name is JOANNES DOMINICUS, where the index has «Dominicum». The first known child of ahnentafel 108 and 109; one godfather is from Šibenik. Read at about 1.5x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 23 April 1750 — Jerolima, widow (udova) Uroda, godmother
rows.where: image 112, left-hand page (book page 200, «Lěto 1750»): the entry of «Dan 23 Apla», a crop of three lines
rows.says: Croatian-language baptism entry; the godparents are «Tadia Kovacevich i Jerolima udova Uroda» (read at about 2x). The first appearance of Jerolima, a widow named Uroda, in these pages.

rows.title: Karlobag, 25 April 1751 — Jerolima, widow Uroda, godmother
rows.where: image 114, right-hand page (book page 205 head, «Dan 25 Aprila 1751»): the first entry of the page
rows.says: «… kumi Pop Miko Martin … i udova Jerolima Uroda»: the priest's own kin stand with her. Read at about 2x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 12 March 1752 — «Jure Uroda» and Jerolima, widow of Dume Uroda, godparents
rows.where: image 116, left-hand page (book page 208, «Lěta 1752»): the entry of «Dan 12 Marca», fourth from the top
rows.says: «… Martina i … Maxuran. Bihu kumi Jure Uroda i Gjerolima udova [Sokoić] Dume Uroda». A man called JURE URODA (Georgius) is godfather with the widow of a Dume (Dominicus) Uroda. The word between «udova» and «Dume» is read as Sokoić and is uncertain.

rows.title: Karlobag, 21 March 1752 — Jerolina, widow [Sokoić] «Dume Uroda», godmother
rows.where: image 116, left-hand page (book page 208), the entry of «Dan 21 Detto» (21 March) at the foot
rows.says: «… Ivana … bihu kumi Lorenco Curtellini [od Sibenika?] i Gjerolina udova Sokoić Dume Uroda». The widow is named with her husband's name Dume Uroda.

rows.title: Karlobag, 3 April 1752 — «Jure» and Jerolina, widow [Sokoić] Dume Uroda, godparents
rows.where: image 116, right-hand page (book page 209, «Dan 2 Aprila 1752»): the second entry, «Dan 3 Aprila»
rows.says: «Dan 3 Aprila … sina Pavla i Franice Bevandich. Bihu kumi Jure i Gjerolina udova [Sokoić] Dume Uroda». Here the godfather is written only «Jure»; a word «Uroda» appears to be written over the line above it, and I read this as the same Jure Uroda as on 12 March; not certain.

rows.title: Karlobag, 11 August 1745 — a daughter (Marta Franceskina, as read) of Dume Uroda and Jerolina
rows.where: image 100, left-hand page (book page 178): the entry «Na 11 Agusta 1745», about two-thirds of the way down.
rows.says: «Na 11 Agusta 1745. Ja Pop Osip Xurich kersti cher Dume urode i xene Jerolime imenom Marta Franceskina [read at one zoom]. Bi kum Don Josep iz Kontra a kuma Lucia xena Uvje Xurica». The only baptism found of a child of Dume Uroda; it names his wife as Jerolina. Croatian text, read at about 3x; the child's second name is uncertain.

rows.title: Karlobag, 10 May 1744 — a son of Dume Uroda and Jerolime (name read as «Gratiova», uncertain)
rows.where: image 96, left-hand page (book page 170): the entry «Na 10 Maia 1744», at the foot of the page
rows.says: «Na 10 Maia 1744. Korstih sina Dume urode i njegove [že]ne Jerolime imenom [Gratiova?]. Bi kum Dno Antonio Alfier [?] Johetoni [?] Gnor … a kuma Gospodjena Mi[…] Agnerin neputa …». Baptism of a SON of Dume Uroda and Jerolima; the child's name is not read with confidence. Croatian text, about 3x; the godparents' names are a poor reading. THE FAMILYSEARCH INDEX READS THIS CHILD AS «GIAKOVA» (JAKOV, JACOBUS) — a son named Jakov, so not Georgius; found 11 October 2026 under the spelling «Urode».

rows.title: Karlobag, mid-1742 — a son of Dume Uroda and his wife, the name read as «… Juria» (possibly Jurja/Georgius; not secure)
rows.where: image 91, right-hand page (book page 161, «Na … Maja 1742» at its head): the last entry on the page, «Na 4 [month, read Ajmilo/Aprila?] 1742»; the month word is unclear, and it follows the entries of 3 and 4 June 1742, so it is probably a later 4th (July?)
rows.says: «Na 4: [month?] 1742. Korstih sina Dume urode i njegove xene [Jerolime?] imenom [Cvidora?] Juria. Bi kum Milo Bulinc(?) a kuma Marija xena Martina Vorbanovića». The child is a SON of Dume Uroda; the given name is two words, the second read as «Juria»/«Furia». Read at the page's full resolution; the first word of the name and the month are not read with confidence. RE-READ AT HIGHER MAGNIFICATION (second image): «Na 4: [Ajmila/Apmila, month not read] 1742 · [K]orstih sina Dume urode i njegove xene … imenom [Gvidora/Evidora] Juria [Furia], bi kum Milo Bulinc … a kuma Marija xena Martina …». «Sina Dume urode» (son of Dume Uroda) is clear; the child's name is two words, the first read as Gvidora/Evidora and the second as Juria/Furia; the month word is not Aprila (the entry follows 3 and 4 June) and is not read.

rows.title: Karlobag, mid-December 1739 — Franica (as read), daughter of Dume Uroda and his wife EVA
rows.where: image 82, right-hand page (book page 147, headed «Na 11 Xbra 1739»): the entry «Na 12 [or 17] Stoga», about a third of the way down
rows.says: «Na 12 Stoga: Korstih ja Andrij Kolekar Plovan cher Dume urode i njegove xene Eve imenom Franica. Bi kum Mathio Milkovich a kuma [..] xena Pave Samonicha». A daughter named Franica to Dume Uroda and a wife named EVA — three years before Jerolina is Dume's wife in the same book. Read at about 3x; the month word is read as «Stoga» (December).

rows.title: Karlobag, 8 March 1734 — a child (name read as Dominico) of Dume Uroda, «alias Horaca» (as read), and his wife EVA
rows.where: image 61, left-hand page (book page 106, headed «Na 14 Febora 1734»): the entry «Na 8 Marca 1734», about two-thirds of the way down
rows.says: «Na 8 Marca 1734: Krstih sina Dume Urode alliti Kovaca [first read as Horaca] i njegove xene Eve imenom Dominico [?]. Bi kum Gior. Angelo Bakj[..] a kuma Marica xena Jane Mega [?]». A baptism to Dume Uroda and a wife named EVA five years before the Franica of December 1739 — the earliest child of this couple seen. The by-name after «alliti» was first read as Horaca; re-read at 3x on 11 October 2026 it is «kovaca» — a smith's by-name (kovač), which would tie Dume to the many Kovačević of Karlobag. Read at about 3x; child's name and godparents' surnames are not firm.

rows.title: Karlobag, 16 January 1733 — Antona, daughter of «Sime» (index) or Dume (?) Uroda and his wife EVA
rows.where: image 57, left-hand page (book page 100, headed «Na 1 Genvara 1733»): the third entry, «Na 16 Genvara 1733»
rows.says: «Na 16 Genvara 1733: Ja Pop Andrij Kolekar Plovan krstih sina [Sime / Dume?] urode i njegove xene Eve imenom Antona. Bi kum Andro Kum[anovich?] soldat od Tortice … a kuma …». The FamilySearch index reads this father as SIME Uroda (baptism 16 January 1733, parents Sime Uroda and Eva). The first letter of the father's name is not firm: it may be a Dume with the capital misread. If it is Dume, Dume and Eva had Antona in January 1733, a child in March 1734 and Franica in December 1739. The same page is repeated on image 56 (duplicate frame).

rows.title: Karlobag, 12 January 1737 — «kuma Eva xena Dume urode» (godmother, wife of Dume Uroda)
rows.where: image 70, right-hand page, lower half: the entry «Na 12 Jenora 1737», third from the foot
rows.says: «Na 12 Jenora 1737: Krstih cher Jve Berondicha [?] njegove xene Eve … ime Gasparina. Bi kum Mato Mato[vich?] a kuma Eva xena Dume urode.» Not a baptism of the Urodas' child: it shows Eva as Dume Uroda's wife in January 1737, between the 1734 baptism and the Franica of December 1739, so the Eva of 1733–39 is one woman. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 7 June 1739 — marriage of Martin Svjata and Simona, daughter of the late DUME URODA «od Šibenika» (of Šibenik)
rows.where: image 279, left-hand page: the entry headed «Dan 7: Junija», after the year heading «Letta 1739» and the entry of 28 May
rows.says: «Dan 7: Junija. Andrij Kollekar Plovan sakupih u S. Matrimonij Martina Svjata [Sviata?] y Simonu pokoi[nog] Dume urode od Sibenika. Biha svidoki Tavia Kovacevich y Bartul Misich.» The wording matches the book's formula for a bride «Heer pokoi X» (daughter of the late X), though the word «Heer» is not written here. So: a DUME URODA from Šibenik, dead by June 1739, with a daughter Simona. The living Dume Uroda of the Karlobag baptisms (wife Eva, daughter Franica baptised December 1739) cannot be this man, so this is a second Dume Uroda — possibly the living Dume's father or another relation, not established — and the first sight of the family as Dalmatian. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Drniš, 13 March 1770 — Josepha, daughter of PAMPAO Uroda and Mariana Bachi, both soldiers
rows.film: Drniš baptisms, 1770 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994, reference 68; index record 1:1:QKMG-2TSF)
rows.where: the left-hand page of the opening, the second entry from the top, headed «Die 13 Martii 1770»; the margin names her «Josepha Uroda»
rows.says: «Ego Fr. Josephus Jakick Capuc. Baptizavi infantem natam sub die primae ejusdem [mensis], ex legitimis Conjugibus Pampao Uroda, et Mariana Bachi, Militum [Illustrissimi?] Domini Capi[tanei] Dulatti [?]. Cui nomen impositum Josepha. Patrinus fuit Stephanus Susszek et Catharina uxor Francisci Pasquali, omnes Militas.» A Franciscan baptises a girl born on the 1st of the month. The father is written PAMPAO (the index reads «Janpao»; 1778 reads «Pompio»), the mother's surname Bachi, and the household is a SOLDIER's, as are the godparents: a military family at Drniš, not a Karlobag one. The words after «Militum» (the captain's name) are not firm. Read at about 4x.

rows.title: Drniš, 26 August 1778 — Julia Magdalena, daughter of CAPORAL Pompeo Uroda and Maria Anna Bachi
rows.film: Drniš baptisms, 1778 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994, reference 112; index record 1:1:QKMG-2VW7)
rows.where: left-hand page of the opening, the entry headed «Die 26 Augusti 1778» that follows the first of two entries of that date
rows.says: «Die 26 Augusti 1778. Ego Fr. Elias Soldich Parochus Darnisii baptizavi infantem natum sub die 23 ejusdem, ex legitimis Conjugibus Caporal Pompeo Uroda et Maria Anna Bachi. Cui nomen impositum Julia Magdalena. Patrini fuerunt Domina Magdalena et Dominus Serdar Antonius Nachich hujus Parochiae.» The father is called CAPORAL — a corporal — and the godfather a SERDAR, a Venetian-Dalmatian militia rank: the same soldier household as in 1770, now spelled POMPEO. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Drniš, 23 October 1780 — Joseph, son of Domino CAPORAL POMPEO Uroda and Maria Anna Bauchi, all soldiers
rows.film: Drniš baptisms, 1780 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994, reference 122; index record 1:1:QKMG-2D3D)
rows.where: right-hand page of the opening, the entry at the top, headed «Die 23 Octobris 1780»
rows.says: «Die 23 Octobris 1780. Ego Fr. Elias Soldich Parochus Curae Darnisij baptizavi infantem natum sub die 13 hujus, ex legitimis Conjugibus Domino Caporal Pompeo Uroda et Domina Maria Anna Bauchi. Cui nomen impositum Joseph. Patrinus fuit Dominus Angelus Sarich et Anna Maria …chin, omnes Milites.» THE INDEX READS THE FATHER AS «TOMASO»; THE PAGE READS POMPEO — so the Drniš baptisms of 1770, 1778 and 1780 are one man, Corporal Pompeo (Pampao) Uroda, and his wife Maria Anna Bachi/Bauchi, a soldier's household. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 2 July 1767 — Petrus Jacobus, son of Georgius and Maria Uroda; godparents the criminal judge Antonius Dorliga and the wife of Antonius Iurich
rows.where: image 161, left-hand page (book page 290, headed «Anno Dni 1767»): the first entry, «2 July»
rows.says: «Ego Joannes Antonius Ivancovich Parochi Administrator baptizavi [Petrum] Jacobum filium legitimum jugalium Georgii et Mariae Uroda natum die 29 [Junii]. Levantibus e sacro fonte Dno Antonio Dorliga, Judice Criminali ac Dna [..]cica conjuge Dni Antonii Iurich.» The line is clipped at the right by the page curvature, so the child's first name and the godmother's own surname are not firm. The father's neighbours are officials, not kin that can be named.

rows.title: Karlobag, 28 December 1769 — Heva Joanna, daughter of Georgius and Maria Uroda; godparents the Chancellor Josephus Kumanović and Sancina, wife of Antonius Dorliga
rows.where: image 173, right-hand page (book page 313, headed «Anno Dni 1769»): the entry «25 Xbris», above the heading «Anno Domini 1770»
rows.says: «Ego Jacobus Mallinarich Capellanus baptizavi Filiam die 28 hujus Mensis natam ex Georgio et Maria Uroda Conjugibus hujus Parochiae, cui impositum est nomen Heva Joanna. Patrini fuerunt Dnus Cancellarius Josephus Kumanovich et Dna Sancina Dorligo Antonij uxor.» (The margin says 25; the text says 28.)

rows.title: Karlobag, 29 April 1772 — Maria Catharina, daughter of Georgius and Maria Uroda; godparents the Chancellor Josephus Kumanović and his wife Joanna
rows.where: image 187, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1772»: the entry «29 ejusdem [Aprilis]», third on the page
rows.says: «Rendus Dnus Jacobus Mallinarich Capellanus Cesaricensis baptizavit filiam heri natam ex Georgio et Maria Uroda Conjugibus hujus Parochiae cui impositum est Nomen Maria Catharina. Patrini fuere Dominus Josephus Kumarovich Cancellarius cum sua Dna Conjuge Joanna.» The same Chancellor as in 1769.

rows.title: Karlobag, September 1773 — Maria Heva, daughter of Georgius and Maria Uroda, «hujus loci Civibus»; godparents Antonius Pomsick and Aloysia, wife of Josephus Collini
rows.where: image 191, right-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1773»: the entry near the foot, before the first of October
rows.says: «Idem Admin[istrator] baptizavit Mariam Hevam filiam ante quinque dies natam ex Georgio et Maria Uroda hujus loci Civibus. Patrini de sacro fonte suscipientibus Dno Antonio Pomsick et Dna Aloysia conjuge Dni Josephi Collini.» The parents are called citizens (Cives) of the town.

rows.title: Karlobag, 13 June 1780 — Antonius, son of Dno Georgius and Maria Uroda; godparents the standard-bearer Antonius Klein and Catharina, wife of the pro-tribune Joannes Kallinich de Zirfeld
rows.where: image 214, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1780»: the last entry, «13 ejusdem» [June]
rows.says: «Idem qui supra Baptizavit Filium anteheri Natum ex Dno Georgio et Maria Uroda Conjugibus hujus Civitatis, cui impositum est nomen Antonius. Patrini fuerunt Dnus Vexillifer Antonius Klein, et Dna Catharina Conjux Dni pro Tribuni Joannis Kallinich de Zirfeld.» Both godparents are of the military garrison.

rows.title: Karlobag, 17 May 1784 — a son, Dominicus Christianus Joannes, of Dno Georgius and Dna Maria Uroda; godparents Nicolaus Samanich and Heva, wife of Joannes Butorović
rows.where: image 229, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1784»: the second entry after «2 Moÿ», «17 ejusdem»
rows.says: «Idem qui supra Capellanus loci baptizavi filium [heri] natum ex Dno Georgio et Dna Maria Uroda conjugibus hujus loci Parochiae. Cui impositum est nomen Dominici Cristiani Joannis. Levantibus e sacro fonte Dno Nicolao Samanich et Dna Heva uxore Dni Joannis Butorovic.» Georgius and Maria are Dominus and Domina here. The index lists this child as «Joannis».

rows.title: Pag, 14 March 1728 — Caietanus Antonius Gregorius, son of Dno ANGELO BACHI, patrician, and Dna Oliva — a candidate for the Caetanus Bachi who married at Karlobag in 1753
rows.film: Pag baptisms, 1728 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994; index record 1:1:XQMM-RTYT)
rows.where: right-hand page of the opening, the last entry, headed «Anno Dni 1728 die 14 Martii»
rows.says: «Anno Dni 1728 die 14 Martii. Ego Frater Gregorius … de licentia Rmi D. D. Joannis Franc. Mirovich Archiepi … baptizavi infantem natum die 12 eiusdem [mensis] de legitimo matrimonio procreatum ex Dno Angelo Bachi Patricio, et Dna Oliva Filia Dni Gasparo Lizavola [?] conjugibus. Cui imposui nomen Caietanus Antonius ac Gregorius. Patrini fuerunt Dns Laurentius Cassius [?] Strenuus Miles nomine Illmi ac Excmi Domini Antonij Zane dignissimi Comitis hujus civitatis Pagi, et Dna Lucia …» The father is a PATRICIAN of the island town of Pag, and the child is named CAIETANUS — the rare given name of the Caetanus Bachi who married Anna Lukatelli at Karlobag on 4 February 1753, aged 24 if this is he; a daughter of his at Karlobag is called OLIVA, like the mother here. (The tree's Angelo, ahnentafel 428, comes only from a DIFFERENT Karlobag baptism of 1779 — a Caetanus Antonius, son of Angelo and Catharina — so he is not evidence for this link; see the 1779 snapshot.) NOT PROVED: the Karlobag entries never name his father or birthplace, and the tree's mother is «Catharina». Pag lies a short crossing from Karlobag. The godfather's title and the mother's father's surname are not firm. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 17 May 1780 — Vitus, son of Paulo and Barbara Smojver, «hujus Civitatis»; godparents Simon Matthievich and Margarita Damiani Budak
rows.where: image 214, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1780»: the entry «17 ejusdem», after the 15th and before the 22nd (the month, May, is by its place on the page)
rows.says: «17 ejusdem. M.R.D. Michaël Martinjazi Baptizavit Filium hodie Natum ex Paulo & Barbara Smojver, Conjugibus hujus Civitatis, cui impositum est nomen Viti. Patrini fuerunt Simon Matthievich & Margarita Damiani Budak.» A Paulus Smojver again at Karlobag, now with a wife Barbara (1763: Ursula) and written without the by-name «Vukić». Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 12 January 1779 — Caetanus Antonius, son of Angelo and Catharina Bachi; godparents the Captain Joannes Jankovich and Maria, wife of Dno Georgius Uroda
rows.where: image 210, left-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1779»: the entry «12 Januarij», the third from the top
rows.says: «12 Januarij. M.R.D. Michael Martinaj Presbyter Curatus Loci Baptizavit infantem hodie natum ex Angelo & Catharina Bachi conjugibus hujatibus, cui impositum est nomen Caetani Antonij. Patrini fuerunt Dnus Capitaneus Joannes Jankovich et Dna Maria uxor Dni Georgij Uroda.» THIS IS THE BAPTISM THE TREE WRONGLY TAKES FOR THE ELDER CAETANUS BACCHI (ahnentafel 214, born 1779 «maybe»): a different, younger Caetanus Antonius, son of ANGELO and CATHARINA — a second Bacchi household at Karlobag in 1779 — and the godmother is MARIA, wife of Dominus Georgius Uroda (ahnentafel 109). Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Betina, 28 November 1835 — Andrea, son of Simeone Uroda and Giovanna Barran, both «a Betina»
rows.film: Betina baptisms, 1835 (FamilySearch Croatia, Church Books 1516–1994, reference 19; index record 1:1:QKMG-896Y; the printed Italian «Libro degli atti di nascita», Distretto di Sebenico, Circolo di Zara)
rows.where: left half of the printed table, entry no. 24; the second entry (no. 23) is Andrea and Nicolò, children of Antonio Moikin
rows.says: Printed form, Italian: «Nato li 28 [ventotto] Novembre 1835 … Battezzato li 28 … Andrea» — masculine, legitimate; mother «Giovanna [Barran] a Betina»; father «Simeone Uroda a Betina»; the parents' marriage (25 February 1835, Betina) and the godfather «Andrea Barazic a Betina» in the columns to the right. The parents are Catholic and live at Betina, in the Šibenik district under Austrian Dalmatia, and nothing on the page says they came from anywhere. The 1829 baptism of Maria «Urodan» (image ref. 20) and the 1839 baptism of Antonio «Urada» (ref. 33) are the same printed form and were opened but add no origin. A resident Betina family of the 19th century, not a Karlobag one. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, «30 [Oct or Nov] 1739» — Jakomo, son of a Jakov Pilipić; godparents Gn. Mik[ula] Zorović and Kate, wife of Gn. Antun Dorliga
rows.where: image 82, left-hand page, the last entry on the page, headed «Na 30: [month] 1739»
rows.says: «Na 30: [Ovra] 1739: Korstih ja Plovan Andrij Kollekar korstih [sina] Jakova Pilipicha imenom Jakomo … [word not read: a place, perhaps «u kaštel»] … bi kum Gn. Mik[ula] Zorović a kuma Kate [Blizi?] Gn. Antona Dorliga.» THE INDEX DATES IT 30 NOVEMBER; THE MONTH WORD (an abbreviation ending «-ovra») COULD BE OCTOBER OR NOVEMBER AND IS NOT FIRM. The child's father is named «Jakov Pilipić» and the godparents are the town's gentry (Zorović; the wife of Antun Dorliga, who in 1767 is the criminal judge) — a man of standing, which fits a captain of the port. NO MOTHER IS NAMED. Several words in the middle of the entry are not read at this resolution. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Šibenik, 3 June 1767 — marriage of Joannes Grubisich and Ariana, daughter of the late Michael Boydanovich alias Pancora; the witnesses include «Dno Dominico Uroda»
rows.film: Šibenik cathedral parish marriages 1752–1787 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-W3R, 468 images)
rows.where: image 373, left-hand page, the first entry, headed «Anno Domini 1767 die vero 3tia mensis Junii»
rows.says: «Ego Presbyter Josephus Caristo Rector Ecclesiae Parochialis S. Benedicti … Joannem filium Michaeli Grubisich ex Parochia Sanctae Mariae Vallis Viridis et Arianam [?] filiam relictae q. Michaelis Boydanovich alias Pancora, Parochiae S. Benedicti, in Ecclesia S. Francisci Fratrum Minorum Conventualium interrogavi … matrimonio conjunxi coram Testibus Matthaeo Xeravizza, et Dno Dominico Uroda, ac multis.» The witness's surname is read as Uroda (V-shaped initial, final «a»); the entry gives no father, place or age. The first Uroda seen in the Šibenik registers; NOT shown to be the Karlobag Dominicus or Dume. Read at about 3x.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 10 August 1762 — marriage of Antonius Loccasovich and Elera Dulitich; the witnesses include «Dno Dominico Uroda»
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) marriages 1701–1764 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2Z-RM9, 554 images)
rows.where: image 469, right-hand page (numbered 91), the first entry, headed «Die 10 Augusti 1762»
rows.says: «Tribus denuntiationibus dispensatis … Ego Presbyter Thomas Jadovon Rector Ecclesiae S. Marci in Suburbio Maris in Ecclesia Cathedrali S. Jacobi interrogavi Antonium filium Francisci Loccasovich et Eleram filiam Petri Dulitich ambos supradictae Parochiae S. Marci … in matrimonium conjunxi, praesentibus testibus Illmo Domino Angelo Semonich alias Perova, et Dno Dominico Uroda aliisque multis.» Read at about 3x; the surname is written with a V-shaped initial and a final «a», the same hand and spelling as the 1767 witness at the cathedral parish. The entry gives him no father, place or age.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 11 September 1759 — marriage of Matthaeus Meich of Zlosela and Antonia, widow of the master Hieronymus Sigovec; the witnesses include «Magistro Dominico Uroda»
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) marriages 1701–1764 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2Z-RM9, 554 images)
rows.where: image 458, right-hand page (the page after p. 80), the second entry, headed «Die 11 Septemb. 1759»
rows.says: «Duabus denuntiationibus … Ego Presbiter Thomas Jadovon Rector Eccl. S. Marci in Suburbio Maris interrogavi in supradicta ecclesia Matthaeum filium qd. Stephani Meich ex Villa Zloseba [Zlosela] Antoniamque relictam qd. magistri Hieronimi Sigoveo, eorumque mutuo consensu habito per verba de praesenti eos solemniter matrimonio conjunxi, praesentibus testibus Magistro Domico [Dominico] Uroda, et Antonio Lucenti aliisque multis.» Read at about 3x; «Domico» is a contracted «Dominico». The title here is «Magister» (a master of a trade), not «Dno» as in 1762 and 1767. No father, place or age is given.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 27 September 1757 — marriage of Matthaeus Kvancich and Lucia, widow of Andreas Segna; the witnesses include «Joanne filio Dominici Uroda»
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) marriages 1701–1764 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2Z-RM9, 554 images)
rows.where: image 450, right-hand page (numbered 75), the entry headed «Die 27 Septemb. 1757», which ends at the foot of the page
rows.says: «Tribus denunciationibus dispensatis ab Reverendissimo Vicario Generali Nicolao Difnico … Ego Presbiter Thomas Jadovon Rector Ecclesiae S. Marci in Suburbio Maris, in Ecclesia S. Rochi, interrogavi Matheum filium qd. Joannis Kvancich et Luciam relictam qd. Andreae Segna, eorumque mutuo consensu habito per verba de praesenti eos matrimonio conjunxi, praesentibus testibus Joseph Fevetti, et Joanne filio Dominici Uroda, aliisque multis.» Read at about 3x. **A son of a Dominicus Uroda, Joannes, of an age to witness in 1757** (the first mention of a Uroda child in the Šibenik registers); the entry does not say who Joannes is, how old, or that the Dominicus is the Dominicus of 1759–1767. Names with doubtful letters: «Kvancich» and «Segna».

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 11 January 1756 — marriage of Silvester (or Saulus) Clavich and Dominica, daughter of the master Joannes Kinchela; the witnesses are «Dominico Uroda et Michaele Cigo»
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) marriages 1701–1764 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2Z-RM9, 554 images)
rows.where: image 446, right-hand page, the entry headed «Die 11 Januarii 1756» at the foot of the page (the page after the one numbered 69)
rows.says: «Die 11 Januarii 1756. Tribus denuntiationibus praemissis … Ego Presbiter Thomas Jadovon Parochus Ecclesiae S. Marci in Suburbio Maris interrogavi in supradicta Ecclesia Silvestrum vel Saulum filium Stephani Clavich, et Dominicam filiam magistri Joannis Kinchela, eorumque mutuo consensu habito per verba de praesenti eos matrimonio conjunxi, praesentibus testibus Dominico Uroda et Michaele Cigo aliisque multis.» Read at about 3x; the first name of the groom is doubtful. The earliest of five sightings of a Dominicus Uroda at Šibenik (1756, 1757, 1759, 1762, 1767), here with no title.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 19 May 1738 — baptism of Lucia, daughter of Michael and Mathea Dragovich; the godmother is «Dna [Su]guetia, uxor Mri Georgij Vroda» (wife of the master Georgius Uroda)
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 117, left-hand page, an entry in the lower half, headed «Die 19 Maji 1738»
rows.says: «Die 19 Maji 1738. Lucia filia Dni Michaelis et Mathee coniugum Dragovich ex hac P[arochi]a S. Marci, in lucem edita die 13 [Maji], Baptizata fuit in hoc Patri[s] Baptisterio per me Franciscum Can[onicu]m Parchych … cui impositum fuit [nomen Lucia]. Patrini fuerunt Philippus Defrateo, et Dna Guetia [the name is unclear, perhaps Suguetia] Uxor Mri Georgij Vroda.» Read at about 3x. **A Magister Georgius Uroda, already married, in Šibenik in May 1738**: the first mention of any Georgius Uroda at Šibenik, and 25 years before the Georgius of Karlobag has a first child. The wife's name is not read with certainty; she is not named Maria. Whether this is the Georgius of Karlobag (ahnentafel 108), his father, or a namesake is not shown.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 12 October 1738 — baptism of Maria, daughter of Antonius and Margareta Vidovich; the godfather is «Magister Franciscus Vroda» (the master Franciscus Uroda)
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 118, left-hand page, the last entry on the page, headed «Die 12 Octobris 1738» (the margin reads «Maria Vidovich»)
rows.says: «Die 12 Octobris 1738. Ego Presbiter Nicolaus Mijagostovich Vice Parochus S. Marci Baptizavi in Baptisterio dictae Parochiae infantem natam sub die 7 Septembris ex Conjugibus Antonii et Margerita Vidovich cui impositum fuit nomen Maria; Patrini fuerunt Magister Franciscus Vroda, et Marta [Marchiani?].» Read at about 3x; the first godparent is a Magister Franciscus Uroda (the surname with the same V-shaped initial as the Dominicus sightings), the godmother's surname is a guess. A second master of the name at Šibenik in 1738, five months after the Magister Georgius Uroda of 19 May.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 30 January 1735 — baptism of Domica, daughter of Joannes and Antonia [surname Maraglia?]; the godparents are «Franciscus Vroda» and Simona [Suraeovich?]
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 111, right-hand page (numbered 4), the second entry, headed «Die 30 Januarii 1735»
rows.says: «Die 30 Januarii 1735. Domica filia Joannis et Antoniae coniugum Maraglia [?] ex hac Par[ochia] S. Marci, in lucem edita die 21 [Januarii], Bap[tizata] fuit in hoc Patri[s] Baptisterio per me … Parochi … Rectorem, cui praesentum nomen impositum fuit. Patrini fuerunt Franciscus Vroda, et Simona Suraeovich [?].» Read at about 3x; the child's surname and the godmother's are doubtful; **Franciscus Uroda**, here without «Magister», is the same name as the master of October 1738, three years earlier. The earliest sighting of any Uroda at Šibenik.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 25 April 1733 — baptism of Maria, daughter of Joannes and Anastasia [surname Maraglia?]; the godparents are «Mr Franciscus Vroda» (the master Franciscus Uroda) and Anastasia [Signorin?]
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 109, right-hand page, the third entry, headed «Die 25 Aprilis 1733» (the margin reads «Maria Maraglia»)
rows.says: «Die 25 Aprilis 1733. Maria filia Joannis et Anastasiae coniugum Maraglia [?], in lucem edita die 20 [Aprilis], Baptizata fuit in hoc Patri Baptisterio per me Franciscum Parchych S. Marci Rectorem, cui praesentum nomen impositum fuit. Patrini fuerunt Mr Franciscus Vroda, et Anastasia Signoria [?].» Read at about 3x; «Mr» is a contraction of Magister; the child's and godmother's surnames are doubtful. **The earliest sighting of any Uroda at Šibenik (1733)**, the same Franciscus who stands godfather to Joannes and Antonia's Domica in January 1735 and, as «Magister», to Antonius and Margareta Vidovich's Maria in October 1738.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 1 January 1741 — baptism of Joana, daughter of Thomas and Lucia Peresich alias Bodulovich; the godparents are «Magister Dominicus Vroda» (the master Dominicus Uroda) and Dominica, daughter of Matthaeus Marchovich
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 123, right-hand page (numbered 17), the first entry, headed «Die 1ª Januarii 1741» (the margin reads «Joana Peresich alias Bodulovich»)
rows.says: «Die [1] Januarii 1741. Joana filia Tomae et Luciae Conjugum Peresich alias Bodulovich ex hac Parochia S. Marci in lucem edita die 30 Decembris, Baptizata fuit in hoc Parochiali Baptisterio per me V[ice] Parochum Nicolaum Mijagostovich, cui praescriptum nomen impositum fuit. Patrini fuerunt Magister Dominicus Vroda, et Dominica filia Matthaei Marchovich.» Read at about 3x. **The earliest sighting of Dominicus Uroda (1741), already a «Magister»**, 15 years before he appears as a witness at Dolac marriages (1756–1762). The Dolac godfather of Šibenik's Uroda: Franciscus (1733, 1735, 1738), Georgius (1738 as a godmother's husband), Dominicus (1741).

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 6 May 1742 — baptism of Georgius, son of Joannes [Presrou?] de Flumine alias Biliznich and of Antonia, «filia q[uondam] Francisci Vrodda de hac Parochia S. Marci» (daughter of the late Franciscus Uroda)
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 126, left-hand page, the last entry on the page, headed «Anno Domini 1742 – Die 6 Maij» (the margin reads «Georgius Biliznich»)
rows.says: «Anno Domini 1742 – Die 6 Maij. Georgius filius Joannis [Presrou?] de Flumine, alias Biliznich, et Antoniae filiae q[uondam] Francisci Vrodda de hac Parochia S. Marci, Coniugum, natus die 17 mensis Aprilis proxime elapsi. Baptizatus fuit in hac Parochiali Ecclesia S. Marci per me Angelum Trapileo; cui impositum fuit nomen Georgius, [ut supra]. Patrini fuere Viscardus Pini, et Dna Cecilia Vidovich q[uondam] Caroli.» Read at about 3x; the father's second name is doubtful. **Antonia is the daughter of the LATE Franciscus Uroda of Šibenik**: so Franciscus (godfather 1733, 1735, 1738) was dead by April 1742, and had at least this daughter, who married a Joannes Biliznich of the same parish. The child is a Georgius Biliznich, not a Georgius Uroda.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 23 April 1741 — baptism of Domica, daughter of Joannes and Antonia Maraglia [?]; the godparents are «Mr Dominicus Vroda» (the master Dominicus Uroda) and Maria Vergada [?]
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 125, left-hand page, the first entry, headed «Die 23 Aprilis 1741» (the margin reads «Domica Maraglia»)
rows.says: «Die 23 Aprilis 1741. Domica filia Joannis et Antoniae coniugum Maraglia [?] ex hac Par[ochia] S. Marci, in lucem edita die prima supradicti [mensis], Baptizata fuit in hoc Patri[s] Baptisterio per me Franciscum Parchych … Rectorem, cui praesentum nomen impositum fuit. Patrini fuerunt Mr Dominicus Vroda, et Dna Maria Vergada [?].» Read at about 3x. **Magister Dominicus Uroda is godfather to a child of the same couple (Joannes and Antonia/Anastasia Maraglia) as Franciscus Uroda was in 1733 and 1735**: the families are bound together, perhaps by kinship, and so, perhaps, are the two Uroda men. The earlier Domica of 30 January 1735 (same parents) presumably died.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), January 1703 — baptism of Paulus, «procreatum ex Joanne Vroda, et Ursula eius conjugibus» (son of Joannes Uroda and Ursula); godparents the master Hieronymus [Magaznich?] and Jacobina, wife of the master Melchior [Bayrinich?]
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 12, left-hand page, an entry in the lower half, headed «Die 2[8] Januarii 1703» (the day is half hidden by an ink blot)
rows.says: «Die 2[8] Januarii 1703. Ego Fr[ater] Paulus Nicolich Vice Parochus in Ecclesia S. Marci in suburbio Maris Baptizavi infantem, cui impositum est nomen Paulus, procreatum ex Joanne Vroda, et Ursula eius conjugibus: Patrini fuerunt [Mr] Hieronymus Magaznich [?] et Jacobina uxor [Mri] Melchioris Bayrinich [?].» Read at about 3x; the godparents' surnames are doubtful, the father's is clear (the same V-shaped initial and final «a» as the Dominicus sightings). **The earliest Uroda at Šibenik: a Joannes Uroda, married to Ursula, with a baptised son in 1703**, thirty years before the first Franciscus.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 31 May 1705 — baptism of Antonius, son of Joannes and Ursula Vrodich [Urodić]; godparents Joannes Micheli and Magdalena, wife of [Dno] Beri [?]
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 19, right-hand page (numbered 15), the second entry, headed «Die 31 Maji 1705»
rows.says: «Die 31 Maji 1705. Ego Fr. Andreas Rovich [Kovich?] Parochus S. Marci in Suburbio Maris Baptizavi infantem natum ex legitimis Conjugibus V[iris] Joanne et Ursa [Ursula] Vrodich, cui nomen impositum fuit Antonius. Patrini fuere Dnus Joannes Micheli et Dna Magdalena uxor Dni Beri Rifinici [?].» Read at about 3x; the surname is spelled «Vrodich» (Urodić), and the same couple, Joannes and Ursula, had Paulus in January 1703 (image 12). The godparents' names are doubtful.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 27 October 1705 — baptism of Simeon, son of Lucas and [Ursula/Anna?] Vrodich [Urodić]; godfather Dominicus Condoguari of the city
rows.film: Šibenik, Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris) births 1701–1784 (FamilySearch waypoint 9R2C-L2Q, 434 images)
rows.where: image 20, right-hand page (numbered 16), the second entry, headed «Die 27 8bris 1705»
rows.says: «Die 27 8bris 1705. Ego Fr. Andreas Rovich Parochus S. Marci in Suburbio Maris Baptizavi infantulum natum ex legitimis Conjugibus [Lucas et …] (Conj: Vrodich) cui nomen impositum fuit Simeon. Patrini fuere Dominicus Condoguari ex Civitate et Brigida uxor q. Gasparini Bra[…].» Read at about 3x; the surname «Vrodich» is clear, the parents' given names are partly lost in the page-edge shadow (Lucas and a woman's name). **A second Uroda couple at Šibenik in 1705**, unconnected on the page to Joannes and Ursula.

rows.title: Šibenik (Dolac parish, S. Marci), 23 October 1710 — baptism of Paulus, son of FRANCISCUS and Anna Vrodich [Urodić], «Conjugum Catholicorum»; godparents Dno Joannes Theodorovich and Jacoba Bonacich

rows.says: «Die 23 8bris 1710. Paulus filius Francisci Vrodich et Annae Conjugum Catholicorum, Baptizatus fuit per me Fr. Philippum Servovich Parochum eccl. S. Marci. Patrini fuerunt Dnus Joannes Theodorovich et Jacoba Bonacich.» Read at about 3x. **The first appearance of the name Franciscus Uroda, with a wife Anna and a son Paulus, in 1710**; the Magister Franciscus of 1733–1738 (dead by 1742, daughter Antonia) is very probably this man, who by 1733 would be a father of grown children, or his son of the same name. Three Paulus Uroda are baptised in the first decade of the book (1703 son of Joannes, 1706 son of Thomas, 1710 son of Franciscus).

rows.says: «Die 28 8bris 1715. Ego Fr. Philippus Surcovich Parochus Vicarius S. Cui nomen impositum fuit Simona. Patrini [fuerunt] D. Georgius Vrodi[ch?] Gasparovich [?] …» Read at about 3x; the mother's name (Lucia?) and the godfather's second surname are doubtful. **A daughter SIMONA of a Franciscus Vrodich in 1715**, with a Georgius (a Vrodi-) as godfather; this Franciscus has a different wife's name from the Franciscus and Anna of 1710 and 1712 (a second marriage, or two Franciscus). The dead «Dume Uroda of Šibenik» of the 1739 Karlobag marriage had a daughter SIMONA who married then; the name is a coincidence at most.
